var TCBR={on:true,err:null,signs:new Map(),n:{sign:0,tile:0,lit:0,litDrawn:0,bus:0,wrap:0,plaque:0,rear:0,poster:0,shelters:0,hooks:0},drawn:{},lit:[],bus:null,busKey:'',

function tcbrErr(e){TCBR.err=TCBR.err||String(e&&e.stack||e).slice(0,300)}
const TCBR_BY_G7={},TCBR_BY_NAME={},TCBR_BY_SHOP={};
for(const k in TC_BRANDS){const b=TC_BRANDS[k];TCBR_BY_G7[b.g7]=k;TCBR_BY_NAME[b.name]=k;TCBR_BY_SHOP[b.shop]=k}


const TCBR_BY_PLACE={},TCBR_SIGNS=(how)=>{const o={};for(const k in TC_BRANDS)for(const s of TC_BRANDS[k].signs||[])if(s[0]===how&&s[1])o[s[1]]={k,ty:s[2]||null};return o};

  C.prototype.getContext=function(t){const g=gc0.apply(this,arguments);if(TCPO.mk&&g&&t==='2d')tcpoCtx(g);return g}}
 const mk=BLD40.make;BLD40.make=function(id,rot){if(TCPO.mk||(id!=='B5MUS'&&id!=='B5THEA'))return mk.apply(this,arguments);const M=TCPO.mk={id,rot:rot|0,marks:[]};let e;
  try{e=mk.apply(this,arguments)}finally{TCPO.mk=null}try{if(M.marks.length)tcpoPlace(M,e)}catch(err){tcpoErr(err)}return e};
 try{BLD40.clear()}catch(e){}TCPO.hookB=true}

 
function tcpoNight(){const d=tcbrDark();if(d<=.05||!(typeof WLD!=='undefined'&&WLD.on)||!TCPO.lit.size||!TCPO.on)return;const a=Math.min(.95,d*1.05),k=tcbrPx(ctx);let x0=-1e9,x1=1e9,y0=-1e9,y1=1e9;
 try{const hw=viewHW()+40,hh=viewHH()+40,cx=viewCX(),cy=viewCY();x0=cx-hw;x1=cx+hw;y0=cy-hh;y1=cy+hh}catch(e){}ctx.save();
 for(const q of TCPO.lit.values()){if(q.x+q.w<x0||q.x>x1||q.y+q.h<y0||q.y>y1)continue;const e=q.kind==='banner'?tcpoBanner(q.b,q.w*k,q.h*k):tcpoPic(q.kind,q.i,q.w*k,q.h*k);if(!e)continue;ctx.globalAlpha=a*.25;ctx.fillStyle='#fff1cf';ctx.fillRect(q.x-1.5,q.y-1.5,q.w+3,q.h+3);ctx.globalAlpha=a;ctx.drawImage(e.cv,q.x,q.y,q.w,q.h);TCPO.n.lit++}
 ctx.restore()}
function tcpoInit(){try{tcpoHookCinema();tcpoHookB4()}catch(e){tcpoErr(e)}}
tcpoInit();
if(typeof wldSkyPaint==='function'){const f=wldSkyPaint;wldSkyPaint=function(now){if(!TCPO.hookC||!TCPO.hookB)tcpoInit();if(!TCPO.warm)tcpoWarm();const r=f.apply(this,arguments);try{tcpoNight()}catch(e){tcpoErr(e)}return r}}
window.__TC_POSTERS={TCPO,ready:()=>TCPO.ready,stats:()=>({ready:TCPO.ready,n:TCPO.n,err:TCPO.err,hooks:{cinema:!!TCPO.hookC,bld40:!!TCPO.hookB},films:TCPO_FILMS,tonight:tcpoTonight(),lit:[...TCPO.lit].map(([k,q])=>[k,q.kind,q.i!=null?q.i:q.b,Math.round(q.x),Math.round(q.y),+q.w.toFixed(1),+q.h.toFixed(1)])}),
 pic:(kind,i,w,h)=>{const e=tcpoPic(kind,i,w,h);return e&&e.cv},banner:(t,w,h)=>tcpoBanner(t,w,h).cv,on:v=>{TCPO.on=!!v;try{BLD40.clear();wtcInvalidate()}catch(e){}return TCPO.on}};
